newsitem.title: USA: Tech Data Corp announces appointment.
newsitem.headline: Tech Data Corp announces appointment.

text.p: Tech Data Corp said Monday it has appointed Anthony Ibarguen as president of the company's North American and Latin American operations.
Ibarguen has been vice president of sales and marketing for ENTEX Information Services, which has its headquarters in Rye Brook N.Y. He is a co-founder of ENTEX.
Ibarguen is expected to start at Tech Data in late September.
He replaces Tim Godwin, who was appointed vice chairman of the company in September 1995. The position has been vacant since then.
